headline: Egypt and World Bank Discuss Sustainable Development and Green Transition
summary: Egypt’s Minister of Planning and Economic Development met with a World Bank delegation to review cooperation portfolios and explore future areas in environmental and economic fields.
why: The World Bank provides financing and technical assistance for developing nations' structural reforms and infrastructure projects. Strategic dialogues signal the trajectory of public sector investments and sovereign funding.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Discussions on green transition cooperation support the country's long-term sustainable development plans.
